resources.string: ⏳ Notification access granted, service not connected yet: press Refresh in a few seconds. If it stays like this: allow autostart for Guardian (app settings button), then turn notification access off and on again.
❌ Service disabled: Notification access settings → Guardian → turn on
✅ Usage access: a \"Force stop\" done from Settings is respected
ℹ️ No usage access (optional): an app you force-stop from Settings is unblocked too

Lock Guardian in recent apps (once)

1. Open recent apps (swipe up from the bottom of the screen and hold).

2. Put the lock on the "Guardian" card (depending on the version: drag the card down, or long-press it then Lock).

3. Tap the card to come back here, then press "Done".

⚠️ Never close this card by swiping it up: vivo would force-stop Guardian.

The lock is remembered after "Done", after a reboot and after an update. It is only lost if the app is uninstalled.
